segments.sn8.2:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ … pe … āyasmā vaṅgīso āḷaviyaṃ viharati aggāḷave cetiye āyasmatā nigrodhakappena upajjhāyena saddhiṃ.
segments.sn8.2:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nigrodhakappo pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto vihāraṃ pavisati, sāyaṃ vā nikkhamati aparajju vā kāle.
segments.sn8.2:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmato vaṅgīsassa anabhirati uppannā hoti, rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti.
segments.sn8.2:1.5: “alābhā vata me, na vata me lābhā; dulladdhaṃ vata me, na vata me suladdhaṃ;
segments.sn8.2:1.6: yassa me anabhirati uppannā, rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti; taṃ kutettha labbhā, yaṃ me paro anabhiratiṃ vinodetvā abhiratiṃ uppādeyya.
segments.sn8.2:1.7: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ attanāva attano anabhiratiṃ vinodetvā abhiratiṃ uppādeyyan”ti.
segments.sn8.2:1.8: Atha kho āyasmā vaṅgīso attanāva attano anabhiratiṃ vinodetvā abhiratiṃ uppādetvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imā gāthāyo abhāsi –
segments.sn8.2:2.3: Vanathaṃ na kareyya kuhiñci, nibbanatho arato sa hi bhikkhu [sa bhikkhu (ka.)].
segments.sn8.2:3.3: Kiñci parijīyati sabbamaniccaṃ, evaṃ samecca caranti mutattā.
segments.sn8.2:4.1: “Upadhīsu janā gadhitāse [gathitāse (sī.)], diṭṭhasute paṭighe ca mute ca;
segments.sn8.2:4.3: Ettha vinodaya chandamanejo, yo ettha na limpati taṃ munimāhu.
segments.sn8.2:5.1: “Atha saṭṭhinissitā savitakkā, puthū janatāya adhammā niviṭṭhā;
segments.sn8.2:5.3: Na ca vaggagatassa kuhiñci, no pana duṭṭhullabhāṇī sa bhikkhu.
segments.sn8.2:6.3: Santaṃ padaṃ ajjhagamā muni paṭicca, parinibbuto kaṅkhati kāla” ntntti.

lines: Aratiñca ratiñcāti sāsane aratiṃ kāmaguṇesu ca ratiṃ.
Sabbaso gehasitañca vitakkanti pañcakāmaguṇagehanissitaṃ pāpavitakkañca sabbākārena pahāya.
Diṭṭhasuteti cakkhunā diṭṭhe rūpe, sotena sute sadde.
Paṭighe ca mute cāti ettha paṭighapadena gandharasā gahitā, mutapadena phoṭṭhabbārammaṇaṃ.
Yo ettha na limpatīti yo etesu pañcakāmaguṇesu taṇhādiṭṭhilepehi na limpati.
Atha saṭṭhinissitā savitakkā, puthū janatāya adhammā niviṭṭhāti atha cha ārammaṇanissitā puthū adhammavitakkā janatāya niviṭṭhāti attho.
Na ca vaggagatassa kuhiñcīti tesaṃ vasena na katthaci kilesavaggagato bhaveyya.
Sa bhikkhūti so evaṃvidho bhikkhu nāma hoti.
Paṭicca parinibbuto kaṅkhati kālanti nibbānaṃ paṭicca kilesaparinibbānena parinibbuto parinibbānakālaṃ āgameti.

lines: Vihāragaruko kiresa theroti etena thero attano saddhivihārikaṃ vaṅgīsaṃ ovadituṃ anavasaro.
Tena antarantarā tassa cittaṃ rāgo anuddhaṃsetīti dasseti.
Yathā mahantaṃ araññaṃ vanathanti, evaṃ mahantaṃ kilesavanaṃ “vanathan”ti vuttaṃ.
Pathaviñca vehāsanti bhummatthe paccattavacanaṃ, tasmā pathaviyaṃ ākāse cāti attho.
Saṭṭhi-saddo cha-saddena samānatthoti “saṭṭhinissitā”ti padassa “chaārammaṇanissitā”ti attho vutto.
Kilesavaggagatoti kilesasaṅgaṇikaṃ upagato na bhaveyya, kilesavitakkā na uppādetabbāti attho.
